scenario: LDAP password expires in 24 hours, re-validate through the campus login portal
subject: Urgent: Your LDAP Password Will Expire Soon
body:
Dear [Student Name],

This is a reminder that your LDAP password will expire in 24 hours. To avoid losing access to your IIT Hyderabad accounts and services, please click the link below to validate and update your password now.

https://portal.training.invalid/verify

Thank you for your immediate attention to this matter.

ITS Help Desk

IIT Hyderabad

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at helpdesk@training.invalid. 

Do not forward this message to anyone or share the link with others. 

Thank you for your cooperation.
